discovery_notes: Follow-up 1 of B021 (DLP 2017). 30 WebSearch calls, standard mode, blocked domains passed; all search_snippet. Reuses 227 keys. dein-dlrp monthly pages for Jan, Feb, Apr, Aug, Oct, Dec gave line items with edition and EUR price; Mar, May, Jun, Jul only as teasers; Sep, Nov not found. Released: october-2017-le members, Coco contents. Lady chateau looks like Apr 2018 (hold added). Resale-only items (mickeyundco shop) not used.
